name: ai-pdlc
description: AI-PDLC documentation assistant for local repositories. Provides search, read, feature-package validation, and scaffolding over repo-local docs/ai-pdlc artifacts.

repoRoot.title: AI-PDLC repository root
repoRoot.description: Choose the project directory that contains docs/ai-pdlc.

tools.name: aipdlc_search_docs
tools.description: Search AI-PDLC docs, feature packages, prompts, and current-task notes.

tools.name: aipdlc_read_doc
tools.description: Read a specific AI-PDLC or current-task document by path, basename, or suffix.

tools.name: aipdlc_validate_feature_package
tools.description: Validate the basic structure of an AI-PDLC feature package.

tools.name: recommend_process_assets
tools.description: Recommend which AI-PDLC docs and prompts to load for a task shape and stage.

tools.name: scaffold_feature_package
tools.description: Create or refresh a feature package from the AI-PDLC templates.
